summary: Personable project manager with over eight years of progressive management experience, adept at building strong professional relationships, managing large and complex projects, and achieving performance targets.

experience.title: Operations Research Analyst
responsibilities: Initiated and managed a program to test incoming radiation detection equipment across New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut.
Developed processes and procedures, instrumented and maintained test facilities, and managed and scheduled testing teams.
Coordinated activities with NYPD Counter Terrorism Bureau, state and local first responder organizations, and Brookhaven National Laboratory.
Oversaw testing of over 25 million dollars worth of equipment and more than 10,000 units.

experience.title: Information Technology Specialist
responsibilities: Managed data collection and test operations for DHS and NYPD collaborative acquisition of roadway radiation detector prototypes.
Planned and executed initial data collection, developed budgets and schedules, and managed test team staff.
Provided technical support on request for information and proposal reviews.
Trained and deployed as a technical expert in radiation spectra analysis, providing rapid assistance to first responders.
Led advanced spectroscopic portal test campaigns and coordinated with federal, local, and law enforcement stakeholders.
Managed the S&T Countermeasures Test Beds collaborative website and coordinated technology installation, integration, and data analysis.

experience.title: Information Technology Specialist
